title: Showreel
line: Excerpts from television, music, fashion, documentary, infomercial, industrial and social work, cut as one reel.

title: Qumra
line: A single line of dots grows into curves, teams and companies in the story of a venture fund.

title: Home
line: Four storybook characters fight over a shared home, then rebuild it under rules they agree on.

title: Ballot 26
line: Hands drop ballots and troubles named on screen dissolve into blue smoke.

title: One Year
line: Posts and poll charts build up into a one-year summary of a supporters’ page before an election.

title: Walter
line: A painted town square turns full circle, with shops, a horse cart and a castle on the hill.

title: The Eye
line: A human eye slowly fills with black until nothing of the iris is left.

title: HOME
line: Artists build a small house of coloured light and ask for help raising it in the Midburn desert.

title: The BMW Test Drive
line: Eight steps take a customer from booking a BMW test drive to driving home in a new car.

title: Airovation Technologies
line: From a clean 2050, the film looks back at how carbon capture turned industrial waste into resources.

title: Bird Song
line: A pirate sails a ship through desert dunes, following a bird and its song.

title: A Union in High-Tech
line: SAP Israel employees tell how a workers committee changed the outcome when global layoffs came.
client: Histadrut (General Federation of Labour in Israel)

title: YouTube Creative Sprint
line: A house becomes a studio where Google and creative teams build performance ads with fifteen advertisers.

title: Through the Lens
line: An optometrist answers parents’ questions about children’s eyesight and getting used to glasses.

title: How to Choose Peppers
line: A farmer in his greenhouse gives a short tip on choosing a good pepper.

title: Operation Ends Soon
line: A commander drills a platoon across the beach to remind it that a phone deal is ending.

title: Not Relevant
line: In a job interview, a candidate in a wheelchair hears that her disability is not relevant.
client: Histadrut (General Federation of Labour in Israel)

title: Mia Sweet Potato Chips
line: A couple on the sofa discovers that a bowl of sweet potato chips changes how they host.

title: Together, for You
line: Two pensioners on a bench discover clubs and activities offered to them after retirement.
client: Histadrut (General Federation of Labour in Israel)

title: The Organizing Division
line: Union organisers explain why they help employees join together and ask for more.
client: Histadrut (General Federation of Labour in Israel)

title: Noga Shalev: Adif
line: A woman in red rides an improvised carriage through the city and into the sea.

title: Everyone Gets a Pair
line: In a hotel corridor, feet in different shoes meet, pass and pair up before a shoe fair.

title: INFINIDAT: Meitav Dash
line: Investment house Meitav Dash explains why it moved to INFINIDAT storage and what sped up.

title: Carnival in the Heart
line: Two singers and their dancers move through coloured sets and neon lights.

title: MediBoard
line: MediBoard gathers a patient’s medical records in one place and helps them talk with doctors.

title: Welfare Minister
line: A man posts an angry comment to the welfare minister, who appears beside him and answers.

title: An Address for Science
line: A woman keeps opening her door to salesmen who quote studies to sell her anything.

title: We Did It
line: Employees of Pelephone and Bezeq International present what their joint labour struggle achieved.

title: Painting with Yuri Katz
line: A painter at work in a dark studio talks about fragility, accident and letting go.

title: Breaking Boundaries
line: Women living with disabilities or after illness tell how they built working lives.

title: SodaStream Women’s Day 2020
line: Women working at SodaStream talk about family, independence and growing at work.

title: XL Cup 2019: We Were There
line: Three footballers remember the XL Cup where they played and invite a new generation to sign up.

title: Gabi Amrani: The Bee
line: An actor in a bee costume explains why he checks the quality mark before buying furniture.

title: OpusClip: The Skeleton
line: A doctor’s teaching skeleton takes over his video and shows how he edits short clips.

title: Moments I Gained
line: Four pairs of family and friends describe life with migraine, before and after preventive injections.

title: How It's Made: SodaStream
line: Inside the SodaStream factory, machines, gas cylinders, bottles and flavours come together for 46 countries.

title: Shoefuni Shoe Fair 2014
line: Faces and shoes are mixed on coloured backdrops to announce a three-day shoe fair.

title: In Whispers
line: A woman tells of years of walking on eggshells until she called a support line.
